forbidden: Do not add requirements, names, numbers, technologies, sizes, colors or preferences that were not spoken.
Do not answer the request; only restructure it.
Do not translate unless the output language setting says so; keep technical terms exactly as spoken.
name: Claude Code
philosophy: Claude Code works autonomously in a repository with tools. Good prompts name the symptom and the desired outcome, separate investigation from implementation when the task is non-trivial, point at what to look at, keep the change scoped, and say how to verify the result. Include these only when the request calls for them; never pad a simple task with boilerplate.

text.en: Inspect the relevant code and how it currently works before changing anything.
text.bg: Първо прегледай съответния код и как работи в момента, преди да променяш нещо.

text.en: Identify the root cause from evidence rather than assuming it.
text.bg: Установи първопричината въз основа на данни, без да гадаеш.

text.en: Keep the change as small as the problem allows and avoid unrelated modifications.
text.bg: Направи възможно най-малката промяна и избягвай несвързани модификации.

text.en: Verify the result with the project's own checks (tests, lint, type-check, build) where they apply, and inspect any failure instead of working around it.
text.bg: Провери резултата със съществуващите проверки на проекта (тестове, lint, type-check, build), където са приложими, и разгледай всяка грешка вместо да я заобикаляш.

text.en: Finish with a concise summary of what you found, what you changed and how you checked it.
text.bg: Приключи с кратко обобщение: какво откри, какво промени и как го провери.

text.en: Do not stop until the stated goal is met and the verification above has passed.
text.bg: Не спирай, докато целта не е постигната и проверката по-горе не е минала.

extractorHints: The reader is an autonomous coding agent that can read the repository and run commands. Name the symptom and desired outcome; keep file or framework names only if the speaker said them.
